message: Thanks. To narrow down what your household may qualify for, I need a few details. How many people live in your household, including you? And how many children under 18 live with you? Also, does anyone in the household get health insurance through a job?
reply: Me, my husband and our two kids. I have my son. Yes, I'm on my company's plan.

summary: Household: Arkansas, 4 people (you, your husband, two children), married couple, household work income about $187,700 a year, everyone healthy, and you have health insurance through your employer. Recommendation: none of the ten programmes appears to fit. SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI, Medicaid, CHIP, and free or reduced-price school meals all have income limits far below $187,700 for a household of four. EITC phases out well below this income. The ACA premium tax credit is not available when an employer offers affordable coverage, which you have. The refundable part of the child tax credit depends on having little tax owed, so at this income it is likely to be zero. If your household income is actually much lower than the figure you gave, or your employer coverage is not affordable, tell us and we can re-screen.
